instruction.text: You are in a bedroom, facing towards the cupboard. Turn around and keep moving forward. In front, you find a brown color door, go pass through the door and you enter into a corridor. On your left, you find some stairs. Get down the stairs, all the way to the ground floor, and you are on the ground floor. To your right, you find a big christmas tree. Stand near that christmas tree and turn towards your left. In front, you find an other door. Go pass through the door and you find some sofa set in front of you. On your right, you find a white color sofa, go near that sofa and you reached your destination.
